question.problem:
$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{8({x}^{2}+{y}^{2})}{\pi }, & \,x\ge 0,\,y\ge 0,\,{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

The joint probability density function $f(x,y)$ for the continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ is shown above. Given that 

$$
\text{E}[X]=\frac{8}{5\pi },\,\text{E}[Y]=\frac{8}{5\pi },\,\text{SD}[X]≈0.2719,\,\text{SD}[Y]≈0.2719,
$$

 
find the correlation coefficient of $X$ and $Y.$ Round your answer to $2$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the correlation coefficient of the random variables $X$ and $Y$ is defined as

$$
\rho =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]},
$$

where

- $\text{Cov}[X,Y]$ is the covariance, and

- $\text{SD}[X]$ and $\text{SD}[Y]$ are the standard deviations of $X$ and $Y.$

First, by applying the rule of the lazy statistician, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[XY] & ={∬}_{{R}^{2}}xy\,f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}}}xy\cdot \frac{8({x}^{2}+{y}^{2})}{\pi }\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{8}{\pi }\text{ }{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}}}({x}^{3}y+x{y}^{3})\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{8}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{1}{[\frac{1}{4}{x}^{4}y+\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}{y}^{3}]}_{x=0}^{x=\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}}}\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{8}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{1}[\frac{1}{4}{(1-{y}^{2})}^{2}y+\frac{1}{2}(1-{y}^{2}){y}^{3}]\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{2}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{1}[(1-2{y}^{2}+{y}^{4})y+2(1-{y}^{2}){y}^{3}]\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{2}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{1}(y-{y}^{5})\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{2}{\pi }{[\frac{1}{2}{y}^{2}-\frac{1}{6}{y}^{6}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{2}{3\pi }\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we compute the covariance and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Cov}[X,Y] & =\text{E}[XY]-\text{E}[X]\cdot \text{E}[Y] \\  & =\frac{2}{3\pi }-(\frac{8}{5\pi })(\frac{8}{5\pi }) \\  & =\frac{50\pi -192}{75{\pi }^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correlation coefficient is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\rho  & =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]} \\  & ≈\frac{(\frac{50\pi -192}{75{\pi }^{2}})}{(0.2719)\cdot (0.2719)} \\  & ≈-0.64,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $2$ decimal places.
